name: EYWA: Notion → Supabase sync (brands) [v3.32 N→S two-way close]

parameters.query:
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- N→S Phase 1 SELECT: per-workspace last-synced timestamp
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- Returns 2 rows (one per active workspace). Each row carries the
-- MAX(notion_synced_at) for brands in that workspace — used as the
-- after-filter cutoff when querying Notion for changes.
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
SELECT
  notion_workspace AS workspace,
  COALESCE(MAX(notion_synced_at), NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') AS last_synced,
  COUNT(*) AS brand_count
FROM brands
WHERE notion_id IS NOT NULL
  AND notion_workspace IN ('vt_intelligence', 'the_gifted_synapse')
GROUP BY notion_workspace
ORDER BY notion_workspace;
